# System Information

## User & Environment

```{r}
# System user name
Sys.info()[c("user", "nodename")]

# Operating system / platform
Sys.info()["sysname"]

# R version
R.version.string

# Platform string (architecture + OS)
R.version$platform

plot(1:10);
```

## Working Directory

```{r}
# Current working directory
getwd()
```

# Installed Packages

## Packages by Library Path

```{r}
# All installed packages, grouped by library path
pkgs <- installed.packages()
pkgs_df <- as.data.frame(pkgs[, c("Package", "Version", "LibPath")],
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Show the distinct library paths
cat("Library paths in use:\n")
print(unique(pkgs_df$LibPath))
```

## Packages in Default Library

```{r}
# Default library (.libPaths()[1]) — usually where install.packages() puts things
default_lib <- .libPaths()[1]
cat("Default library:", default_lib, "\n\n")

default_pkgs <- pkgs_df[pkgs_df$LibPath == default_lib, ]
cat(sprintf("Number of packages: %d\n", nrow(default_pkgs)))
print(default_pkgs)
```

## Package Count Summary by Library Path

```{r}
# Summary table: how many packages live in each library
lib_summary <- table(pkgs_df$LibPath)
print(lib_summary)
```

## All Libraries, cont.

```{r}
# Show any remaining packages in other library paths
other_libs <- setdiff(unique(pkgs_df$LibPath), default_lib)
if (length(other_libs) > 0) {
  for (lib in other_libs) {
    cat("\nLibrary:", lib, "\n")
    print(pkgs_df[pkgs_df$LibPath == lib, c("Package", "Version")])
  }
} else {
  cat("No packages in other library paths.\n")
}
```
